sr.title: Sphere Rigidity
sr.long_title: Rigidity of unit spheres in finite-dimensional real normed spaces
sr.short_description: A study of how the metric structure of a unit sphere determines its ambient real normed space, with a separate route toward reusable proof tools.
sr.summary: The preliminary Brief Report presents the mathematical statements and proofs. Draft R2 refines citations and attribution and clarifies notation. No mathematical statement, hypothesis, conclusion, or proof argument was changed.

claim.label: CLAIM PRESENTED IN THE BRIEF REPORT
claim.text: Finite-dimensional real normed spaces with isometric unit spheres are linearly isometric as normed spaces.
claim.qualifier: This is an existence statement about the two spaces. It is not a claim that a prescribed sphere isometry extends to a linear isometry.
claim.preview_note: This is a preliminary, AI-assisted manuscript. Full human verification of this report version has not been completed.

naimark-problem.title: Naimark's problem
naimark-problem.long_title: A proposed ZFC construction and its formal-source record
naimark-problem.short_description: A proposed ZFC construction of a single C*-algebra with one irreducible equivalence class and a faithful separable tracial representation.
naimark-problem.summary: The Brief Report presents a proposed ZFC construction of a unital, simple, infinite-dimensional C*-algebra whose nonzero irreducible representations are all unitarily equivalent, yet which admits a faithful tracial representation on a separable Hilbert space. Its two principal arguments classify the irreducible representations of one concrete generated algebra and show that extending the trace of its CAR subalgebra does not enlarge the cyclic GNS space. The manuscript includes proofs, point-of-use references, and cardinality consequences. Its formal-source and human-verification records must be displayed separately.
